examples.name: Sample — industrial-group-financial-report-2024_p15
paragraphs: Two bar series in euros and a percentage line share one canvas; no value axis is drawn, and every mark prints its value, so every cell is copied rather than read. Full coverage is 15 values under the legend entries, copied whole (Earnings per share (EUR) keeps the parenthesis printed inside the legend). The chart prints decimal commas (2,08, 48,1%), and the cells keep them. The earnings values are printed in bold.

snippets.text:
March 26, 2025, the Management Board will propose a dividend of 2.60 EUR per share (2023: 2.50 EUR) for the 2024 financial year. This is equal to a payout ratio of 51.8% (2023: 48.5%).
Earnings per share (EUR) Dividend per share (EUR) Payout ratio
2020 2,08 1,00 48,1%
2021 3,28 1,65 50,3%
2022 4,14 2,10 50,7%
2023 5,15 2,50 48,5%
2024 5,02 2,60 51,8%
